purpose: Define what counts as truth when compiler outputs are compared, and how conflicts are classified. No layer may override a lower layer.

layers.name: frozen-language-contract
layers.description: The pinned ISO C / GNU C dialect and AAPCS64/Linux ABI documents. Ultimate authority for defined behavior.

layers.name: hand-audited-fixtures
layers.description: Defined-behavior fixtures with spec citations, reviewed by a human. Each fixture carries its own expected result.

layers.name: differential-evidence
layers.description: Independent GCC and Clang executions of the same defined program. Agreement is evidence, not proof.

layers.name: abi-observers
layers.description: Assembly-level observers and metamorphic tests derived from the ABI contract.

layers.name: kernel-boot
layers.description: Integration and liveness witness only. A booting kernel can never resolve a semantic conflict from layers 1-4.

independence.requirement: The two differential oracles must differ in vendor, resolved realpath, and binary sha256.

rejectedAliases.reason: On macOS this is an Apple Clang compatibility alias, not GNU GCC. Treating it as GCC would collapse the two-oracle design into one oracle.

conflictPolicy.undefinedBehavior: UB inputs never produce a single golden result; they are classified EXPECTED_REJECT or excluded from differential comparison.
